source: BK3 printed pp.43-44 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF pp.49-50; Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Speculative (Step 7): every expect is derived by hand from the printed wiring (no errata) and the p.43 rule (light 2 ON when relay 1 is not energized). Only light 2 ON with relay 1 out is printed (A/III-RELAYNOT); light 2 with relay 1 ON and the pushbutton-to-relay drive are unprinted (programs.json printedUnprinted). Topology: pushbutton 1 (1Y on 1+, 1X on 1C) drives relay 1 C-F through its indicator lamp; light 2 is fed from 1+ through the set-1 arm 1H and normally closed contact 1J (jack-map: J = normally closed, proved by this page). No contact feeds the coil, so there is no latch. The 500 ms advance before each expect lets lamps finish their thermal transients; the page states no timing.
